commit 5f021579d9a2ce029ba72ff708cb315241e433e3 (+3073, -55)
Author: Lab Builder <lab-builder@lab.invalid>
Date:   Mon Sep 21 15:53:10 2026 +0000

    feat(ace-git-github),feat(ace-git-forgejo): add provider packages owning all forge behavior
    
    Foundation chunk F0 (8wk.t.l1e / 8vu.t.l2d.1 + .2):
    
    ace-git-github (0.1.0) owns all GitHub behavior moved out of the core:
    - gh CLI invocation with timeout and classified failures (CliExecutor)
    - gh pr output parsing with normalized evidence translation (PrFetcher)
    - GitHub identifier formats including github.com PR URLs (PrIdentifier)
    - GitHub issue task-linkage sync (IssueSync; legacy alias removed)
    
    ace-git-forgejo (0.1.0) introduces first-class Forgejo support behind the
    same contract:
    - fj CLI invocation, auth verification per configured server host
    - minimal-style output parsers for PRs, issues, Actions checks, repository
    - classified failures only; ad-hoc curl fallbacks strictly excluded
    
    Both providers implement the shared Providers::Base contract, register in
    the core provider registry, and pass the identical parity suite shipped in
    ace-support-test-helpers (ProviderContract) against scripted fakes.
    
    Also: ace-git bumped to 0.24.0 (provider gemspec floor), ResolvedServer
    moved to its own file, monorepo wiring (Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, suite and
    runner config with new providers/contract/core test patterns).

commit 997287784551275b8faf19e3e69b612b2f439322 (+1167, -11)
Author: Lab Builder <lab-builder@lab.invalid>
Date:   Mon Sep 21 15:26:46 2026 +0000

    feat(ace-git): add provider contract, server registry, and failure taxonomy
    
    Foundation for forge-neutral Git core (8wk.t.l1e / 8vu.t.l2d.0):
    
    - ServerRegistry resolves forge servers deterministically: explicit named
      servers, exactly-one-default resolution, and remote-URL matching with no
      hostname assumptions (scp/URL/port forms normalized by Atoms::ServerUrl)
    - ResolvedServer identity value exposed to consumers
    - Providers registry + Providers::Base abstract contract: the core defines
      the interface and normalized evidence while provider packages own all CLI
      invocation and output parsing
    - Normalized evidence types: ProviderPullRequest, ProviderIssue,
      ProviderCheck, ProviderRepository
    - Full classified failure taxonomy in git/errors.rb
    - Atoms::PrIdentifier neutral identifier parsing (number, owner/repo#N)
    - git.servers configuration section with validation
    - Core boundary proof: local Git operations succeed with provider CLIs
      scrubbed from PATH
